actual: REPRODUCE: (1) ask '国城矿业的基本情况近期走势未来趋势怎样' -> assistant returns a clarification asking to pick one dimension (financials/kline/quote); (2) user replies '给我全方位的分析' -> assistant returns NO reply at all (silent no-response). DEFECT: a turn must never end silently; it must always produce a reply or an explicit insufficient/blocker message (no-silent-error principle). Likely root cause to diagnose: the follow-up turn after a semantic clarification is not re-planned/continued correctly (clarification context not carried, or planner returns clarification/no_tool again and the reply path yields empty assistant_text, or an exception is swallowed). SCOPE NOTE: the broader 'comprehensive multi-dimension analysis needs multiple tools' capability is handled architecturally in BUG-403 (single-tool planner -> agent loop). THIS bug specifically tracks the SILENT no-response defect: ensure every turn yields a non-empty, on-topic reply (or explicit insufficient), add a regression test for 'follow-up after clarification always replies'. If BUG-403 lands first and subsumes the reply path, carry the regression test into it. CONSTRAINTS: no silent except/empty reply; fix in worktree, not root; no service start.
closure_requirements: Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.
